title: BitstreamFile
description: Bitstream file (bitstreams.json) for the FAU flowgraph deployer: each board, and the bitstream binaries it can be loaded with live via fpgautil. NOTHING about how to reach a board belongs here -- no serial port, baud rate or destination directory. Those are per-session facts an engineer sets from the Port menu or --port, because a port recorded in a file is a port that goes stale and deploys to the wrong board. Logins live in the gitignored credentials.json. Hand-maintained alongside core/boards.py's validation (this package is stdlib-only and does not use Pydantic); tests/test_boards.py validates the tracked files against this schema so the two cannot drift.

propertyNames.description: Board name, e.g. 'S10'. Free-form, but kept to characters that survive a menu label and a command line.

BoardBitstreams.description: Bitstream name -> board-side path. Names are free-form; 'bootstrap', 'tx' and 'rx' are the conventional ones, and 'bootstrap' is listed first wherever modes are offered. A mode this board does not have is simply an absent key -- there are no nulls and no placeholders.

additionalProperties.description: Path ON THE BOARD to the bitstream: absolute, or relative to the login user's home (the deployer never changes directory before running fpgautil). Must be the bootgen-processed '.bit.bin' form that fpgautil's FPGA-manager path wants, not a raw Vivado '.bit'.

bootstrap.description: The baseline design this board is returned to. Conventional name only; it is loaded exactly like any other entry.

tx.description: The design that puts this board in TX/DAC mode, which is what fau_sink requires.

rx.description: The design that puts this board in RX/ADC mode, which is what fau_source requires.
